reviews.text:
I'm giving it 3 stars because I had a 9:30 appointment this morning and was at the vet's door at exactly 9:30. However, the vet was closed; the shutters weren't open yet. If you give me a 9:30 appointment, the place should be open at least 5 minutes earlier, or at 9:30. We waited outside for 5 minutes with my cat already stressed and tired. I check the address before the first appointment and have no idea where they are. Why? I took time off from work to come with my cat and was there exactly at the time you gave me. Why do you make me wait outside with my cat? Do you really have the right to do that?

The staff, except for the doctor, is disinterested, unprofessional, and I honestly can't understand their behavior. I called the front desk and they spoke very calmly without even saying something like "we're opening now." They didn't apologize or offer any explanation. A BIG ZERO for everyone else!

I was treated shamefully by the doctor in the office. She was visibly agitated, I don't know why, and seemed impatient when my Golden Retriever was afraid to have the fur near his neck shaved for a post-bite checkup. Still impatient, she said he needed to be completely sedated or given tranquilizers and then possibly sedated as well (is tranquilizer + sedation a normal thing to do?). I don't know if she's the owner of the facility or not, but when you do this job, you have to be calm and collected. The lady was agitated, anxious, and made both the dog and me anxious. It's a shame because in the past I'd gotten along well with the other vets at the facility. They won't see me again.

Terrible, very negligent, I had a terrible experience with them. They don't even give you the medical reports after the visit, I had to ask for them. I'm giving one star because it's the minimum required.

This week, my cat Olli passed away, after 20 years of living with and caring for us at this clinic.
I must say that, as painful as it can be, the clinic staff truly manages to be there for you in the most humane and respectful way possible :)
We had no doubts. Dr. Chiara has been caring for our pets for 15 years, and just looking into her eyes tells you she has a huge heart, as well as being extremely competent.
Excellent clinic, even on a human level; they know how to guide you in any situation in the right way :)
Thank you

I thank the entire Ca Bianca Veterinary Clinic for the care you provided to our cat Olly for 15 years. A special thanks to Chiara, who helped us with great professionalism even during the most difficult time ❤️.

Only now, almost three months after my dog's death, am I able to share my experience.
I have been a client of this clinic for many years and have always greatly appreciated the kindness and consideration of the entire staff.
I greatly appreciated these qualities when my dog ​​was diagnosed with an inoperable tumor, and the doctors accompanied me throughout the entire "resistance" process.
They treated Gioia with great care and dedication during times of great suffering, trying to make the situation as light as possible.
They understood, supported, and accompanied me during my reluctance to accept this disease. Their compassionate gazes and words of support at the time of euthanasia were a caress.
A special thanks to Drs. Monica and Chiara, and also to Andrea.

I brought my two-year-old cat to this clinic for blood tests, which had already been done three times before at other clinics without any stress, as he is very docile and calm. I didn't use any medications, tranquilizers, or sedatives. Obviously, I took my time and patience, as being a young cat, he squirmed and tried to escape. After several attempts, the doctor couldn't find the vein, either in his hind or front paw, causing the cat to lose patience, rightly so. I was sent home with the cat under the influence of a tranquilizer and returned three hours later, as recommended. Even though the cat was under the influence of medication, the three doctors who were present at the time couldn't take the blood test because the cat was still too agitated. I believe he was exhausted after such stress (he even bit his lip, drawing blood). I should point out that before the blood test, we performed an abdominal ultrasound, which undoubtedly agitated him and made him difficult to handle. That said, I expected something different from professionals with a VERY docile cat. Despite everything, they added a blood test to my bill, which I found quite disappointing considering I was already paying a very high fee for the other tests they performed.

Words cannot describe the kindness, professionalism, and helpfulness I encountered when I turned to the Ca' Bianca Clinic.

I needed to arrange very specific tests to take my Doberman to South Africa, and after so many annoyed responses from other clinics and laboratories that treated me with condescension and total disinterest, here I felt listened to and cared for during a very delicate phase where nothing was simple or obvious.

It's rare to find people who practice this profession with love, competence, and true vocation. Here, I found the best and more.

Heartfelt thanks to Dr. Della Croce and Lucia!

An update to your reply follows.

Unfortunately, changes aren't always improvements; sometimes they're worse (and this is the case).
Animals are now seen as bearers of money.

In response to yours:
Let's talk about little Tea!
I'm saying that €40.00 was paid without a visit. The doctor only listened to her heart, and we don't know why...anyway, we only spent a few minutes.
We talked because we noticed blood while brushing her teeth.
The doctor didn't do anything to the dog you've known for 11 years.
So much so that she said it was just a checkup as she left the office.
I didn't realize you asked my husband for payment!
A little disappointed, but I understand that things and situations change, but not always for the better.
Anyway, good luck...that's always the saying, even if you don't agree with the sentiment!

We arrived without an appointment for a possible emergency with my mom's cat. The doctor was incredibly kind and managed to squeeze in a quick visit even though they only see by appointment. She was very attentive and empathetic with both the cat and us, performing a thorough examination and reassuring the kitten. After the visit, we stayed in touch to discuss the progress of the issue. She's an exceptional veterinarian in every way, with an incredible ability to listen and provide reassurance to both the cat and humans. I highly recommend her and will return if needed.

Yes, I had taken my cat to the veterinary clinic, which I had already known for some time. I went there on Monday, August 26th, but unfortunately my cat didn't survive. The doctor attempted the impossible, and that's how it went. However, I always give 5 stars, and I recommend it. Have a good evening.

Very attentive to the needs of our furry friends.
Reliable and professional. I had my cat spayed and with their technique, she didn't even have to wear a collar. Recommended.
Unnecessary tests on animals should be sent immediately to the emergency room.
Thank you to Dr. Della Croce for your kindness and expertise. My cat, Outzo, sends you my warmest greetings. Maura De Nardis Marinoni

Friendly, efficient, and competent.
Very sweet with our furry friends and understanding with us.
They've been caring for my cats for about 20 years.
